usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks and Zoho WorkDrive holds your files, so “New Task Created in Project” runs “Create Folder”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Folder” in Zoho WorkDrive
bestTemplate.why: Each new task gets its own folder ready for its files.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so the folder appears after a scheduled check.
